segments.text:
V. 30.
That ye may eat and drink at my table—That is, that ye may enjoy the higheſt Happineſs, as Gueſts, not as Servants. Theſe Expreſſions ſeem to be primarily applicable to the twelve Apoſtles, and ſecondarily, to all Chriſt's Servants and Diſciples, whoſe Spiritual Powers, Honours and Delights are here repreſented in figurative Terms, with Reſpect to their Advancement both in the Kingdom of Grace and Glory.
